title: Relief Advocate Full Duty still rolls Repair 0 vs DC 12
body:
Relief Advocate (Mediation 4, Repair 0) on Full Duty / Full Compact still funnels the load-bearing Broken Paling check into **Repair d20+0 vs DC 12**. Mediation never applies. A fail-by-1 is patched by emergency strip and 2 HP at dawn.

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`, seed-base `1900000000`): **7** S2 reports in ticket `4ffaf479dec5c854`. Example seed `1900000000` (record `74f7249f2db2a9a2e860dede32d0e50e7ad1af21a28372723c21c0aadcb2c8f4`). One of the four would-replay-yes players still called this out: the Advocate path never uses Mediation.

Fix: let Mediation (or another authored Advocate skill) participate in the outer-seal check, or stop offering Relief Advocate as if it changes the FORTIFY math.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave ticket 4ffaf479dec5c854 (7 S2 reports) on build 36ff6d10.
